goal: Make mj cert issue work for a live site alias. Follow openspec/specs/site-certs/spec.md, ADR 0013, and openspec/changes/add-sites-alias-certs/design.md. Site-only install writes [[cert]] and does not add [[domain]]. Renewal reinstalls and never appends a missing [[domain]], on every branch.

anchors.invariant: App custom domain owns the host. Else a live alias issues with domain insertion off. Else 404 name_not_found.
domain: false skips ensure_domain_block. Default remains append.
Missing file and ArgumentError are :not_found. Parse failure and other read errors are {:error, reason}. lookup_alias stays miss-on-error.
Mirror gateway classify. Local or Iroh is 409 before HTTP-01. Missing base file is :reject. Other base read failures are 503 gateway_config_unreadable.

acceptance.command: mix test test/mjolnir/api/certs_test.exs test/mjolnir/api/router_test.exs test/mjolnir/gateway/certs_test.exs test/mjolnir/gateway/classify_test.exs test/mjolnir/api/sites_token_auth_test.exs test/mjolnir/sites/alias_secret_store_test.exs && cargo test -p mjolnir-gateway --bin mjolnir-gateway site_only_cert_does_not_change_classification --manifest-path native/Cargo.toml

inherited: ADR 0013 at c93cda3 is accepted. Living spec folded at 8c8390d.
Renewal never appends a [[domain]] that is not already present, including strangers such as zine.identikey.io.
Renewal does not re-apply 409. An unreadable alias index fails the pass before Let's Encrypt.
ops.ensure is 4-arity so fakes see domain: true or false.
